name.description: Username for the new account. Must start with a lowercase letter or underscore, followed by lowercase letters, digits, underscores, or hyphens, with an optional trailing `$`; 32 characters or fewer.

uid.description: Numeric user ID. If omitted, the system assigns one.

gid.description: Primary group ID. If omitted, a group matching the username is created.

password.description: Initial password. Sent in plaintext over TLS, hashed by the controller before the job is stored, and never written to disk or logs in plaintext.
